sources.title: When and What Products Can I Trade?
facts: The listed permitted products include all twelve roots in the proposed carry universe.
Positions must be closed each weekday and cannot be held from one session to the next.

sources.title: Futures Margin Rates
facts: The public table distinguishes long and short overnight margin by futures root.
Published margin may change and the trade desk must confirm current account requirements.

sources.title: Futures Physical Delivery
facts: TradeStation does not accommodate physical commodity delivery.
Customers must close or roll positions before applicable delivery notice periods.
